schemaVersion.description:
SchemaVersion is the document format version, "crosswalk/v1". Optional;
when absent, version 1 is assumed.

framework.description:
Framework identifies the framework and its edition, in lowercase, such
as "iso-27001-2022" or "soc2-tsc-2017".

source.description: Source says who made the mapping, such as a publisher or "operator".

license.description:
License is the terms the mapping is shared under, as an SPDX
identifier or a short statement.

mappings.description: Mappings lists each criterion and the controls that meet it.

Crosswalk.description: Crosswalk maps one framework's criteria to controls.

criterion.description:
Criterion is the framework's identifier for the criterion. Identifiers
only: no criterion text.

controls.description:
Controls are the NIST SP 800-53 control IDs that together meet the
criterion.

Mapping.description: Mapping is one criterion and the controls that meet it.

title: Crosswalk
description: A framework's criterion identifiers mapped to NIST SP 800-53 control IDs, with the mapping's source and licence. Identifiers only.
